studies.Title: Oxidant-antioxidant levels in patients with bladder tumours.
studies.Reference: Oxidant-antioxidant levels in patients with bladder tumours.
studies.Journal: The aging male : the official journal of the International Society for the Study of the Aging Male
studies.Population: Patients with superficial bladder tumour and healthy volunteers
studies.comparison_type: Bladder tumour patients versus healthy volunteer controls (serum antioxidant enzyme/glutathione levels)

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: Thirty patients with bladder tumour with superficial bladder tumour and 27 normal healthy volunteers were included in the study. Four cc of venous blood was taken from these patients and volunteers in the control group and centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 10 minutes and divided into serum and plasma.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: Thirty patients with bladder tumour with superficial bladder tumour and 27 normal healthy volunteers were included in the study.
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: Antioxidant parameters (glutathione-s-transferase, reduced glutathione, superoxide dismutase and glutathione reductase) in the serum of patients with bladder tumours were found statistically significantly lower than control group
extraction_supporting_text.exposure_measurement: The activities of xanthine oxidase, glutathione reductase, glutathione-s transferase, reduced glutathione and superoxide dismutase enzymes in serum were then measured spectrophotometrically.
